title: Disabling basal on no BG readings
symptom: User asks if there is a setting to disable basal after X minutes of missing BG readings. They describe a case where BG was high due to night pressure, then sensor died for a few minutes but basal was still kept high, leading to hypo later.
cause: The failure was due to a connection issue (device out of range), so AAPS was not able to disable basal because Omnipod was also not in range.
fix: No fix was provided; the issue was closed as not an issue. The user concluded that if it were just a sensor error, it would likely be disabled otherwise.
evidence_quote: I know what was wrong. This failure was because of connection issue (device out of range), so AAPS was not able to disable basal because Omnipod was also not in range.
